blocker.summary: The r399 allocator double-issue is RESOLVED (r413/r414/r415). The r418-r421 shutdown hang is FIXED and LIVE-VERIFIED (r422), with automated regression coverage added (r424). Separate, not-yet-fixed discovery from r424: HEAD has never been buildable from a byte-for-byte fresh clone (native_vulkan_backend.cpp has never had Vulkan linkage in any committed CMakeLists.txt) -- named for a dedicated future cycle. r427-r430 closed the presented_frames=0/present=0 chain functionally: r427 found the host's own VdSwap stub never constructed the XE_SWAP PM4 packet a real kernel would; r428/r429 confirmed the front-buffer argument (double-buffering address pattern) and queried the real present target's dimensions live (1280x720). r430 then found r429's PM4-injection plan was built on a wrong model -- discover_write_index_locked() reads the ring's write index from the game's OWN device-object field (+10952), completely independent of VdSwap's own cursor argument, so there was never a valid ring offset to inject into. This matches real Xbox 360 hardware: VdSwap programs the display scanout directly, it is not a PM4 ring command. Applied a much safer fix instead: NativeGuestVdService::publish_write_address (native_guest_vd.cpp, VdSwap's sole entry point) now calls backend_->present_to_offscreen(...) directly with a PresentPacket built from present_target_'s live width()/height() -- no guest memory writes, no ring-corruption risk. Live-verified: present_count increments 1->5 across the 5 VdSwap calls in a 25s window (AC6_NATIVE_VD_TRACE=1 trace: 'vd swap presented 1280x720 present_count=N'). ac6recomp's own printed presented_frames=0 diagnostic still shows 0 -- expected, not a fix failure: diagnostics_.presented_frames is only ever updated inside the separately-identified dead code path NativeRuntime::submit_ring() (r292/r418), never resynced from backend_.present_count() on the real path -- out of this fix's scope by design (one bug at a time). Native ctest 11/11, standalone (non-gdb) launch still exits cleanly (26s, exit=0), repo gates and root ctest green. Named for r431: wire diagnostics_.presented_frames to backend_.present_count() on the real path so ac6recomp's own printed diagnostic finally reflects what this cycle fixed. The standing uncommitted-tree situation (r239+, over the 2026-09-02 mass deletion) remains the user's decision, untouched beyond what r422 already swept in -- reports and named tool/source changes for r413-r430 were committed individually.
